title: OKX referral code: what it really does

scenes.title: OKX referral code
scenes.sub: What it does, in under a minute

lines.show: An OKX referral code is a short code you type at sign-up that links your new account to the person who invited you.
It can also make you eligible for the current new user program.
Many people think a code gives them a special account.

scenes.title: Same account, same rules
scenes.text: The code only links you to an inviter.

lines.show: It doesn't. Your account, your fees and your security settings stay the same.
The current welcome offer and its terms are shown in the app's rewards page.
Download the official app from your app store.
Copy the code exactly, with no extra spaces.
Enter it before you finish sign-up, because it can't be added later.
The code used in this video is XOACPQFC.
Type it in the referral field on the first sign-up screen.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, use code XOACPQFC when you sign up.
Then check the rewards page for the current terms.
